method_note: Historical deployment examples are a curated sample, not a census of all warehouse drone activity. Status and geography reflect the cited source at publication.

timeline.title: Early logistics experimentation
timeline.body: A Flemish logistics-sector initiative launched a study with KU Leuven and industry partners to test drone applications, including indoor and outdoor inventory management at the Port of Antwerp.

timeline.title: Commercial warehouse inventory use cases documented
timeline.body: The ETH Zurich warehouse review lists PINC with Kenco Logistics in the US and Hardis Group with FM Logistics in France as commercial, in-use inventory-management applications. Walmart also publicly demonstrated a warehouse inventory drone in June 2016; the company described it as an early test.

timeline.title: More logistics pilots and deployments emerge
timeline.body: The ETH Zurich review records warehouse inventory applications involving GEODIS in France, Rigterink Logistik in Germany, and Bolloré Logistics in Singapore. It also lists an Audi intralogistics prototype in Germany.

timeline.title: IKEA warehouse stock-taking pilots
timeline.body: IKEA-related pilots included Aeriu in Budapest, Hungary, and a local employee-led drone trial in Bangkok, Thailand. The ETH review also records other experimental indoor logistics and inspection cases.

timeline.title: First broad warehouse-use-case review
timeline.body: ETH Zurich's white paper identified 12 indoor warehouse drone use cases across inventory management, intralogistics, and inspection/surveillance. It noted that inventory management had the strongest evidence, while public evidence for inspection deployments remained limited.

timeline.title: IKEA moves from local pilots toward adoption
timeline.body: Following pilots with different providers, IKEA managers chose to continue testing and begin implementing drone-based inventory solutions in warehouse operations from 2020.

timeline.title: Verity drones roll out in IKEA Switzerland
timeline.body: The IKEA case study reports adoption across five warehouse stores and one distribution center by December 2021. The first Verity drone flight at IKEA took place in Switzerland.

timeline.title: IKEA reaches 100 autonomous drones
timeline.body: A March 2023 report described 100 autonomous drones performing stock inventory across 16 IKEA locations in seven European countries.

timeline.title: IKEA reports 250+ drones across 73 locations
timeline.body: Ingka Group reported more than 250 drones operating across 73 locations in nine countries. It also described plans to explore unit-load and rack-inspection functionality; this is a development direction, not confirmation that rack inspection was already deployed at scale.

case_source.title: Applications of drones in warehouse operations
case_source.note: The 12 cases above are the white paper's identified use-case sample. Some are experimental, prototype, patent, or future concepts—not completed commercial deployments.
